paragraphs: I work on Caspeco Booking, building the online booking system for restaurant guests and staff.

jobs.context: Vietnam · Customer data and experience software
paragraphs: Joined as the second engineering hire and helped build Filum’s customer data platform from early development through its first client release. The platform brings customer information, feedback, and reporting into one place to help businesses understand their customers.
The company later raised US$1 million from investors including VinVentures, Nextrans, and TheVentures.

Worked on an e-commerce mobile app for Boston Pharma Vietnam, connected to its SAP business management system. The app lets customers browse product information and place orders as part of the company’s sales and supply-chain operations.
I met with the client in person, gathered requirements, designed the mobile app, and helped deliver it through launch.
